entities.name: Mamiya Rinzō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mamiya Rinzō  was a Japanese explorer of the late Edo period. He is best known for his exploration of Karafuto, now known as Sakhalin. He mapped areas of northeast Asia then unknown to Japanese.
